chunks: Except those idolaters with whom you have a treaty, who have not failed you in the least, nor helped anyone against you. Fulfil your obligations to them during the term (of the treaty). God loves those who take heed for themselves.
ai.seo_question: When should Muslims honor their treaties with polytheists according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often contextualized within the Treaty of Hudaybiyyah, highlighting the divine mandate for contractual fidelity as a manifestation of taqwa. It establishes that peace treaties remain binding unless actively breached, serving as a practical legal principle for Muslim governance and diplomacy. The emphasis on 'those who fear God' underscores that keeping promises is not merely a political necessity but a spiritual obligation rooted in divine love.
